caption: The drawing features a single cylindrical object placed centrally on a neutral, off-white background. The object resembles a pot or vessel with a flared rim and a rounded, wide body which tapers slightly at the base. The vessel is primarily a pale beige or earthen color with a slightly glossy finish. Around its upper section, blue decorative patterns, possibly stylized plant or leaf motifs, are visible. There is a small, curved handle on the right side of the object, also colored beige with some blue shading. The top of the object has a wide, inward depression with a central circular opening. The composition includes a thin rectangular border in a light red or rust color. In the lower left corner within the border, there is a small schematic line drawing of the vessel, labeled with arrows indicating dimensions. The bottom right corner has small text: "VINCENT ROSÉ. DAL 2524".
title: Crockery Cuspidor
